CC: painful callus and new burning sensation in the forefoot
HPI: weeks of symptoms relating to extensive callus burden with pain on ambulation. Patient also reports a distinct symptom requiring separate evaluation. PMH: Type 2 diabetes mellitus.
Exam: plantar callus area consistent with extensive callus burden with pain on ambulation. Separately identified: tenderness at a distinct anatomic location with documented quality, palpable swelling, and pain on resisted motion.
MDM: discussed risks and benefits of the planned procedure; patient consents. Mentioned other complaints, no separate management plan.
Procedure: Paring of extensive hyperkeratotic lesions performed. Tolerated well, no immediate complications.
